module-2-inventory-watchlist-project.label: Module 2 Restock Watchlist Project
module-2-inventory-watchlist-project.summary: Build one restock query that narrows affordable products into an actionable low-stock stationery watchlist.

mp-1-find-budget-products.title: Start with affordable products
mp-1-find-budget-products.prompt: The buyer first needs products priced below `20`. Return `id`, `name`, and `price` from `products`, in that order.
mp-1-find-budget-products.hint: Start from the product columns, then add one strict price condition.

help.concept: Begin a cumulative filter with the broadest approved rule.
help.hint_1: Add a WHERE clause that keeps prices strictly below 20.
help.hint_2: The boundary value 20 should not be included.

mp-1-find-budget-products.starterCode:
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  price
FROM products;
mp-1-find-budget-products.solutionCode:
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  price
FROM products
WHERE price < 20;

sourceChecks.message: Use the `products` table in the FROM clause.
Select the required columns in the requested order: `id`, `name`, `price`.

mp-2-focus-on-stationery.title: Narrow the list to stationery
mp-2-focus-on-stationery.prompt: The buyer only restocks stationery from this budget list. Keep the existing price rule and narrow the result to Stationery products.
mp-2-focus-on-stationery.hint: Preserve the working budget condition and add a second condition that must also be true.

help.concept: AND extends a working filter when every approved rule must remain true.
help.hint_1: Keep the existing price rule and add the category requirement rather than replacing it.
help.hint_2: Both conditions must pass for a row to remain.

mp-2-focus-on-stationery.starterCode:
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  price
FROM products
WHERE price < 20;
mp-2-focus-on-stationery.solutionCode:
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  price
FROM products
WHERE price < 20
  AND category = 'Stationery';

mp-3-finish-watchlist.title: Flag the low-stock items
mp-3-finish-watchlist.prompt: Warehouse staff need the final restock list. Add `stock` to the result and keep only products with at most `15` units in stock, while preserving both earlier rules.
mp-3-finish-watchlist.hint: Start from the approved stationery query, add stock to the SELECT list, then add one inclusive upper-bound condition.

help.concept: A cumulative project extends the same working query instead of restarting each milestone.
help.hint_2: The value 15 must remain in the result, so use an inclusive upper boundary.

mp-3-finish-watchlist.starterCode:
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  price
FROM products
WHERE price < 20
  AND category = 'Stationery';
mp-3-finish-watchlist.solutionCode:
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  price,
  stock
FROM products
WHERE price < 20
  AND category = 'Stationery'
  AND stock <= 15;

try_module_2_inventory_watchlist_project.title: Preview Budget Products
try_module_2_inventory_watchlist_project.prompt: Before adding category and stock rules, preview the budget products. Return `id`, `name`, and `price` from `products` where `price` is less than `20`.

sketch_project_brief.title: Project brief
sketch_project_brief.bodyMarkdown:
A neighborhood office-supply shop is preparing its Friday restock order.

The buyer wants to begin with affordable products, then narrow the list to stationery. Warehouse staff will take that approved query and add one final rule so only low-stock items remain.

Build one watchlist that becomes more useful at each handoff. Do not restart from a blank query between milestones.
